name: Da Nang International Fireworks Festival
nameVi: Lễ hội pháo hoa quốc tế Đà Nẵng
summary: Ten teams compete over the Han River across six nights. In 2026 the festival site’s theme was United Horizons, and the nights ran from 30 May to the finale on 11 July. Dragon Bridge sits in the same view. A grandstand ticket, if one is sold that year, is check on arrival.
when: In 2026 the nights were 30 May, 6 June, 13 June, 20 June, 27 June, and 11 July. Next year’s dates are check on arrival.
